description: detect fixtures (plan §13 Detection row, §7.4): each case is materialized in a temp directory (object values are written as JSON files) and detected with `platform` (default linux) and a tool lookup where every tool exists unless `tools` says otherwise (cargo-nextest is absent by default). `expect` is a partial match: arrays must have the same length, objects only the listed keys; `*_re` keys are regexes, `*_include` keys are subsets; `is_test` / `not_test` / `project_for` exercise isTestFile and projectForFile.
